svg.title: Ananya explains a same-day treatment change to the patient.
svg.desc: Ananya sits level with the patient and uses two plain diagrams to explain the old and corrected treatment. Riju turns the terminal away, preserving privacy while the patient reviews the change.
svg.text: Page 30, panel 3 · Quiet eye-level consultation shot

text.tspan: The patient receives a plain explanation and can ask
questions before the corrected treatment begins.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
